staging.actions_schema: kind fix = field patches [{key, field, op: set|add|remove|replace, value|from/to}]; kind decision = a JD ruling that closes the flag when chosen; kind task = work staged for Luna’s next council pass (no direct patches); kind merge = opens the Merge studio preloaded with {survivor, loser}.
staging.entry_shape: {flag, action, label, kind, patches?, merge?, state: staged|done, ts, by, outcome?}
staging.execution: Do-now runs the action’s patches through queuePatch / sbPostBatch (batch endpoint, by profile key), then the result is verified against the Sheet. Executed entries are marked done in the queue cell and folded into council.json by Luna’s next pass.
staging.mechanism: Staged council actions are stored as a JSON queue in the Profiles column "Council Staged" (BH) on JD's row ig:jdmeyers_ (Sheet row 314). The app writes it through the Apps Script batch endpoint ADDRESSED BY KEY — never through the directory: JD has two directory entries (ig:jdmeyers_ and an sf:jdmeyers_ shell at row 673) and pkey() resolves both to 'sf:jdmeyers_', so a directory patch would land on the wrong row. The endpoint resolves patch fields against the Profiles header row by name (Location-on-file precedent, no endpoint code change). The board reads the queue from the baked profiles.json (sync pull range widened to BH; council_staged added to PROFILE_FIELDS); Luna's passes read the same cell via the Sheets API.
